description: Hold-out genuine case, written blind from the brief's family description. The message is simulated and the people in it are illustrative. A partial refund for a small defect, with a photo. The photo is an illustrative drawing.

messages.body: Hi, my woven tote (KIK-1028) arrived with one handle fraying. I still want to keep it, so would a partial refund of $15 be possible? Photo attached.
